concepts_present.evidence_quote: Default boxes are similar to the anchor boxes used in Faster R-CNN, however we apply them to several feature maps of different resolutions.
SSD discretizes the output space of bounding boxes into a set of default boxes over different aspect ratios and scales per feature map location.
Predictions of different scales by adding multiple convolutional feature layers, allowing detection at multiple scales.
Output the final detections after thresholding and non-maximum suppression.
Loss = localization + confidence loss across default boxes.

concepts_absent.rationale: SSD has no region-proposal step; predictions are direct from feature maps.
SSD uses per-location prediction + NMS, not set prediction.
SSD is fully convolutional VGG-16-based; no transformer.
SSD uses hard negative mining, not focal loss.
